_: Page apps (STUDIO-RA): flavours that open one page of the site on its own, without the orOS shell. Key = Gradle flavour; package = applicationId (permanent once published); page = the folder (its index.html and its hand-written manifest.webmanifest; the app catches only links under it). Icons: icons/solo/<key>-*.png (tools/solo-icons.js). android/tools/gen.js, app/build.gradle and tools/fdroid-metadata.js read this file.
